prompt_template: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE square transparent user avatar of the exact approved Riffit gecko mascot in reference image, wearing {outfit}. Preserve pale sage gecko skin, creamy throat, enormous glossy dark forest eyes with white highlights, tiny dot nostrils, warm smile, curled tail, friendly flat illustrated sticker style with dark green outline. Full body sitting, same front three-quarter view, centered with 8 percent margin, all headwear and tail inside frame, face dominant unobstructed, crisp silhouette readable at 40 pixels. Only outfit changes; same character proportions. Keep simple clear outfit silhouette. No backdrop, no ground, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha.
